name: יְרִיבַי
summary: A son of Elnaam, one of David's mighty men with his brother Joshaviah (1Ch 11:46). The name is the imperfect יָרִיב “he contends” with the ending ־ַי of short names, perhaps shortened from a name like Joiarib, “Yahweh contends”; scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Eliel the Mahavite, וִירִיבַי and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam.”
“He will surely plead (רִיב יָרִיב) their cause”: the verb in the name.

note: Takes t.cm.ag (1 token). The reading as a shortened theophoric name is a reading of the form only.
